title: Getting sql data type mismatch error in pyspark filter function
question: I am getting below error in the code df1=df.filter((col('A')=='xf')) The data type ntext and varchar are incompatible in the equal to operator
answer:
As steven said you can cast it either while query or filtering in pyspark.

I got the same error while filtering in SQL server.

Solution.

SELECT * 
FROM ExampleTable 
WHERE CAST(Description AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) = 'xf';

So, you do any of the below way.

query = """
SELECT CAST(A AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS A, *
FROM your_table
"""
df = spark.read \
    .format("jdbc") \
    .option("url", "jdbc:sqlserver://<server>:<port>;database=<database>") \
    .option("query", query) \
    .option("user", "<user>") \
    .option("password", "<password>") \
    .load()

After using above query you directly filter it.

or

from pyspark.sql.functions import col

df1 = df.withColumn("A", col("A").cast("string"))
filtered_df = df1.filter(col("A") == "xf")

Cast it in pyspark transformation then filter it.

If you don't want any of this then you update the schema in database table to supported type that is nvarchar(max) or varchar(max)
